youtube.title: The US Air Force Studied Nuking the Moon | Project A119
youtube.description:
In 1958–59 the Armour Research Foundation, working for the US Air Force Special Weapons Center, produced 'A Study of Lunar Research Flights' (Project A119), a report on detonating a nuclear weapon on or near the Moon. Its own introduction names the motives as scientific, military and political, and warns of 'a considerable negative reaction' from world opinion. A young Carl Sagan worked on the project. It was never carried out, and became public around 2000 when project leader Leonard Reiffel confirmed it.

📂 Case File #012: Project A119

Sources: 'A Study of Lunar Research Flights, Vol. I' (AFSWC-TR-59-39, 19 June 1959), via the National Security Archive: https://nsarchive2.gwu.edu/NSAEBB/NSAEBB479/docs/EBB-Moon02.pdf
DTIC copy: https://apps.dtic.mil/sti/tr/pdf/AD0425380.pdf
Overview: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Project_A119
Images: US Air Force / NASA (public domain, Wikimedia Commons).
Narration voice: AI.
